description.zh: Fashion Lab中的《墙》《灵》《根》从概念、效果图、平裁与立裁推进到样版、样衣、Fitting、修版和最终成衣。
description.en: Wall, Spirit and Root in the Fashion Lab portfolio develop from concept, illustration, flat cutting and draping through patterns, toile, fitting, revision and final garment.

description.zh: 我在《幻》中独立完成了从3D视觉设计、建模、场景与材质制作到动画和最终渲染的完整流程。
description.en: In Huan, I independently completed the full process from 3D visual design, modelling, scene and material creation through animation and final rendering.

description.zh: 我在GLITCH IN THE HIVE中参与并完成了导演、编剧、摄影、表演、素材管理、剪辑、调色、特效、配音与声音设计等端到端影片制作。
description.en: In GLITCH IN THE HIVE, I worked across direction, writing, cinematography, performance, media management, editing, grading, effects, voice and sound design to complete an end-to-end film production.

description.zh: 我在SonySIE合作项目中使用TouchDesigner连接声音与3D参数，构建了实时视听和交互表演系统。
description.en: In the SonySIE collaboration, I used TouchDesigner to connect sound with 3D parameters and build a real-time audiovisual and interactive performance system.

description.zh: 我在个人音乐作品中持续完成作词、作曲、编曲、音乐制作、混音和声音处理。
description.en: Across my personal music portfolio, I continue to write lyrics, compose, arrange, produce, mix and process sound.

description.zh: 我长期通过GitHub调研和定制开源项目，同时持续进行网页开发、创意编程与小型工具制作。
description.en: I use GitHub continuously to research and customise open-source projects while developing websites, creative-code experiments and small utilities.

description.zh: 我在Obfuscation Identity Archive中整合了Three.js、网页问卷、AI API、GitHub自动归档和Vercel部署，形成一套自动化3D网页系统。
description.en: In Obfuscation Identity Archive, I integrated Three.js, web surveys, AI APIs, automated GitHub archiving and Vercel deployment into an automated 3D web system.

description.zh: 我在Digital Alchemy中探索了Veo 3.1所处生成式视频技术阶段的能力与限制，并把AIGC影像纳入传统调色和后期流程。
description.en: In Digital Alchemy, I explored the capabilities and limitations of generative video in the period represented by Veo 3.1 and integrated AIGC footage into conventional grading and post-production.

description.zh: 我在浙江理工大学学习服装设计与工程，随后在伦敦时装学院学习侧重可持续时尚的Fashion Futures，并在本科毕业论文中测算和可视化了中国服装产业对外贸易隐含碳。
description.en: I studied Fashion Design and Engineering at Zhejiang Sci-Tech University, followed by Fashion Futures at London College of Fashion with its focus on sustainable fashion, and calculated and visualised embodied carbon associated with foreign trade in the Chinese garment industry for my undergraduate thesis.

description.zh: 我曾在挪威和扎金索斯独立自驾，从杭州骑行五天到南京，组装过ITX及多台电脑，并实践过家庭服务器、STM32自动浇水、Arduino服装灯光和独立签证申请。
description.en: I have driven independently in Norway and Zakynthos, cycled from Hangzhou to Nanjing over five days, built ITX and other PCs, and worked with a home server, STM32 automated watering, Arduino garment lighting and independent visa applications.
